Observations (not defects):
- O1 `extension_charge_calculation_9af250e7` "Points of reading": "The rate read is the locked nightly rate on the stay record, whatever the stay type's published rate is on the day of the extension." This is the baseline's own content (source baseline: "The added-night rate is the nightly rate locked at booking in the standard method"); it sits beside the factor tier that selects the published rate of the stay type on record, which is the normal baseline/factor relation of this corpus. It did not mislead the blind audit.
- O2 Policy-side note: "the stay type the stay was booked as" has no stay field; it is read from the planned-stay segment's `tier_billed` (source `condition` says so). The visible ledger exposes it, so the edge is resolvable.
